source.rule: For each item type within a traditional redundancy, the total QTYPL times NRL must not exceed the installed ItemStructure.QTYPM. No particular converter error code is stated.

delta: Accepted two-item series parent has NRL2, TEACH-LRU-01 QTYPL1 and installed QTYPM2. Change only LRU RedundancyLink.QTYPL to2, making four nominal LRU positions exceed two installed; change ProblemDescription as provenance label. AUX link QTYPL1, ordinary rates, maintenance, stock, seed1, three missions and horizon36 stay fixed.
predeclared_native_acceptance: The accepted parent source/signoff/native closure remain hash-bound. An immutable session-0 SSH run preserves GUI PID13340 and host-wide serial mutex; input, contract, exact diff, runner and executable hashes match before and after.
Native JSON import/export and exact 23-populated-table business roundtrip succeed, retaining LRU QTYPL2 and AUX QTYPL1.

Native calculation emits at least one conversion error specifically relevant to redundancy item quantity exceeding installed system item quantity. Preserve exact native error codes and text. The calc exit code alone is not evidence.

The invalid model produces no valid nonempty SXO, event log or JSON report. If it converts successfully, errors are unrelated, or valid simulation output exists, the rejection hypothesis is NO-GO and the run remains diagnostic.

A separate read-only reviewer replays exact source delta, raw seals and the converter outcome without author imports before publication. Only the bounded rejection may be published, not simulation behavior.
limits: One item type in one ACTIVE two-link, two-item-series redundancy on one installed SIMLOX 2017 executable. Error precedence, other quantity ratios, PASSIVE links, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine behavior remain unverified.
The accepted parent is the valid boundary control from an earlier guarded run rather than a fresh paired same-day control.
